§a【Tier 6 LuV】Ultimate Compressed Mega Factory§r
123T's core flagship machine — the Ultimate Compressed Mega Factory.
Integrates fifteen industrial processing modes (switch category with a screwdriver, switch internal mode with Programmed Circuit 20/21/22):
  Metal category: Compressor, Lathe, Electric Polarizer
  Fluid category: Fermenter, Fluid Extractor, Extractor
  Misc  category: Laser Engraver, Autoclave, Fluid Solidifier
  Isa   category: Isa Mill, Industrial Froth Flotation, Vacuum Drying Furnace
  Col   category: Molecular Reassembler, Brewery, Fluid Heater
Parallel formula: parallel -2 for each voltage tier increase, minimum 9, default 256.
